Combine the signed form and all your documents into a single PDF file.
Email the PDF to the PI and Co-PI at [email protected] and [email protected]. Put the advertisement number (26FP002) in the subject line.
Send it by 12 November 2026. Do not send a hard copy to the Institute.
Documents to include in the PDF:
Mark sheets and/or certificates for your educational qualifications, showing your percentage of marks or division
For questions about eligibility, you can call Prof. Chandrakant Genu Dalbhagat on 8348561119 or Prof. Shubham Mahendra Nimbkar on 8652827983.

content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.information: By email, as a single PDF

content_sections.heading: Project Details
content_sections.text: The JRF will carry out research and development work in line with the approved project objectives. The work focuses on paddy soaking, parboiling, milling and ageing of rice, and on extrusion processing.

rows.information: Improved Technology and Process for Parboiled Rice and Selected Extruded Products

content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The post lasts 01 year and 05 months. It is purely temporary and contractual, and it ends when the project is completed.

content_sections.heading: NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 28 years. Age is counted as on the last date for receipt of applications, which is 12 November 2026. You need a B. Tech with an M.Tech in one of these fields, with a minimum CGPA of 6.5/10.0 (or 60% aggregate): Food Process Engineering Food Engineering and Technology Food Technology Processing and Food Engineering Agricultural Process Engineering Post Harvest Engineering Agricultural Engineering Preference goes to candidates with prior research experience in operating and handling a twin-screw extruder, rice milling equipment and paddy parboiling equipment. Knowledge of machine design, CAD software, Artificial Intelligence–Machine Learning (AI-ML) modelling and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulation is desirable. Qualifying GATE/NET or another relevant national-level examination is an additional advantage. Experience in a discipline or area of work is counted only from the date you gained the minimum required qualification. For the full eligibility details of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted on merit and on the needs of the project. Having the minimum qualification does not guarantee an interview call. NIT Rourkela may set higher criteria for shortlisting from the candidates who meet the advertised qualification. Only shortlisted candidates will be told about the online interview. Selection or joining will be cancelled if any information or document is found to be suppressed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Rourkela Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Documents to include in the PDF: Mark sheets and/or certificates for your educational qualifications, showing your percentage of marks or division Research papers, if any Work experience certificates, if any For questions about eligibility, you can call Prof. Chandrakant Genu Dalbhagat on 8348561119 or Prof. Shubham Mahendra Nimbkar on 8652827983. All other terms and conditions follow the funding agency's guidelines for this position, as amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. What does the JRF at NIT Rourkela get paid?
faq.answer: INR 37,000.00 per month for Year 1 and Year 2 of the post.

faq.question: Q2. How long is the JRF post?
faq.answer: 01 year and 05 months, on a temporary contract that ends with the project. The project's closing date is 24 March 2028.

faq.question: Q3. Which M.Tech subjects are accepted?
faq.answer: Food Process Engineering, Food Engineering and Technology, Food Technology, Processing and Food Engineering, Agricultural Process Engineering, Post Harvest Engineering or Agricultural Engineering. You also need a B.Tech, and your marks must be at least a CGPA of 6.5/10.0 or 60% aggregate.

faq.question: Q4. How much age relaxation can a female candidate get?
faq.answer: Female candidates, like SC, ST and PWD candidates, get 5 years' relaxation on the upper age limit of 28 years. OBC (Non-creamy layer) candidates get 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is GATE or NET required?
faq.answer: No. It is not part of the essential qualification, but qualifying GATE/NET or another relevant national-level exam counts as an additional advantage.

faq.question: Q6. Which experience gets preference?
faq.answer: Prior research experience in operating and handling a twin-screw extruder, rice milling equipment and paddy parboiling equipment.

faq.question: Q7. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write the advertisement number, 26FP002, in the subject line of your application email.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to post a hard copy?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no hard copy is needed. Send everything as one PDF by email.

faq.question: Q9. When and how is the interview held?
faq.answer: Online, on 16 November 2026 at 10:00 AM, by the Department of Food Process Engineering. Only shortlisted candidates will be told about it.

faq.question: Q10. Who is funding the project?
faq.answer: IIT Kharagpur funds the project "Improved Technology and Process for Parboiled Rice and Selected Extruded Products" (project code SR/26/FP/002).
